notes: SR21 forbids WITH LOCK / WITH NO LOCK under automatic locking. With PB5620 landed (the 2002 Format 1 order parses), re-probed at --std 2002 on the merged head of golden-2002-1: the MANUAL Format 1 statement in the 2002 order (END-OF-PAGE phrases, then WITH LOCK) compiles and prints W 00 N=2, its AUTOMATIC twin is refused COBOL5993 at the WITH LOCK; Format 2 (random relative) likewise: MANUAL WITH LOCK and WITH NO LOCK write and read back, AUTOMATIC refused COBOL5993 at each. The DIVERGES that named PB5620 was the parser's refusal, not SR21's.
